summary: Phase 1a Protection engine + Scenario Compare View fully verified. All 6 engine golden tests pass, all 4 API integration tests pass, and end-to-end Playwright tests covering the 3 Insurance tabs (Life/DI/LTC) + Scenario Compare pinning (incl. max-2 replace-oldest) all pass.
critical_code_review_comments: engine/insurance.py: calculate_capital_retention has no guard for withdrawalRate==0 (returns 0 but could divide-by-zero if logic ever changes — currently safe via ternary).
Retirement.jsx togglePin uses `[p[1], id]` to drop oldest — correct, matches spec (keeps last 2). No action needed.
protection.py returns raw engine dicts (no response_model). Fine for internal use but consider typed Pydantic responses for openapi docs.
seed_data_creation: Created 3 TEST_ retirement scenarios during Playwright run, all cleaned up after.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1a Protection endpoints (/api/plan/protection/life|di|ltc) are stable. DIME defaults -> 2,465,000; DI employer-paid ON group of $4000 -> after-tax $2,680; LTC defaults (200*5*365) -> pool $365,000, premium >0, break-even age 95. Scenario Compare on /retirement Scenarios tab works: pinning two cards renders a 8-row comparison table (Portfolio@retirement, Estate, Guaranteed income, Lifetime tax, Retirement age, Province, Expected return, Desired income); pinning a 3rd replaces the oldest (max 2).
